info.name: MPL Analytic API - Automation Test Suite
info.description:
Automation test untuk semua endpoint MPL Analytic API.

Base URL:
- Apache/Laragon: http://127.0.0.1/manajemen-proyek-kelompok-4/mpl-analytic/public
- VirtualHost: http://manajemen-proyek-kelompok-4.test
- PHP built-in: http://localhost:8000

Newman CLI:
npx newman run docs/mpl_analytic_postman_collection.json --env-var baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1/manajemen-proyek-kelompok-4/mpl-analytic/public

exec: pm.test("[Schema] success, message, data", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("data"); });

pm.test("[Schema] data.season.season_id", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.have.property("season"); if(j.data.season&&j.data.season.season_id){pm.collectionVariables.set("seasonId",String(j.data.season.season_id));} });
pm.test("[Schema] data.schedule is array", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.schedule).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON object", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.be.an("object"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message"); });
pm.test("[Schema] data is array if 200", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); if(pm.response.code===200){pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array");} });
pm.test("[Schema] data is array if 200", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); if(pm.response.code===200){pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array");} });

pm.test("[Schema] heroes array with hero_id", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.above(0); var h=j.data.find(function(x){return x.hero_id===1;})||j.data[0]; pm.expect(h).to.have.property("hero_id"); pm.expect(h).to.have.property("hero_name"); pm.collectionVariables.set("heroId",String(h.hero_id)); });

pm.test("[Schema] hero_id matches var", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; var h=j.data.hero||j.data; pm.expect(h).to.have.property("hero_id"); pm.expect(String(h.hero_id)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("heroId")); });
pm.test("[Schema] data not null with stats", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test("[Schema] data not null", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test("[Schema] data not null", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test("[Schema] data not null", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });
pm.test("[Schema] data array", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array"); });

pm.test("[Data] results match keyword", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.above(0); j.data.forEach(function(h) { pm.expect(h.hero_name.toLowerCase()).to.include("dyr"); }); });
pm.test("[Schema] data array", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array"); });

pm.test("[Data] results match role", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.above(0); j.data.forEach(function(h) { pm.expect(h.role.toLowerCase()).to.eql("mage"); }); });
pm.test("[Schema] data array", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array"); });

pm.test("[Data] results match both keyword and role", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.above(0); j.data.forEach(function(h) { pm.expect(h.hero_name.toLowerCase()).to.include("a"); pm.expect(h.role.toLowerCase()).to.eql("fighter"); }); });

pm.test("[Schema] players array", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(j.data[0]).to.have.property("player_id"); pm.collectionVariables.set("playerId",String(j.data[0].player_id)); if(j.data.length>1){pm.collectionVariables.set("player2Id",String(j.data[1].player_id));} });
pm.test("[Schema] data.length <= 10", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data.length).to.be.at.most(10); });

pm.test("[Schema] comparison.player_1 and player_2", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.have.property("comparison"); pm.expect(j.data.comparison).to.have.property("player_1"); pm.expect(j.data.comparison).to.have.property("player_2"); });

pm.test("[Schema] radar stats for player_1", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); if(j.success&&j.data&&j.data.comparison){var s=j.data.comparison.player_1.stats; if(s){pm.expect(s).to.have.all.keys("kill_power","farm_rate","survival","versatility","objective","teamfight");}} });

pm.test("[Schema] league_stats, detail_stats, and performance for player_1", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); if(j.success&&j.data&&j.data.comparison&&j.data.comparison.player_1){var p=j.data.comparison.player_1; pm.expect(p).to.have.property("league_stats"); pm.expect(p.league_stats).to.have.all.keys("match_played","avg_kda","kill_participation"); pm.expect(p).to.have.property("detail_stats"); pm.expect(p.detail_stats).to.have.all.keys("gold_per_minute","damage_per_minute","objective_secured"); pm.expect(p).to.have.property("performance"); pm.expect(p.performance).to.have.property("win_rate");} });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("message"); });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });

pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON + extract matchId", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); if(j.success&&j.data){var d=Array.isArray(j.data)?j.data:[j.data]; if(d.length>0&&d[0].match_id){pm.collectionVariables.set("matchId",String(d[0].match_id));} } });
pm.test("[Schema] data.match_id exists", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.have.property("match_id"); });

pm.test("[Schema] team1 and team2 with team_name", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); if(j.success&&j.data){pm.expect(j.data).to.have.property("team1"); pm.expect(j.data).to.have.property("team2"); pm.expect(j.data.team1).to.have.property("team_name"); pm.expect(j.data.team2).to.have.property("team_name");} });
pm.test("[Schema] data not null", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.data).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });
pm.test("[Schema] data is array if 200", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); if(pm.response.code===200){pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array");} });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });

pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON + extract gameId", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); if(j.success&&j.data){var d=Array.isArray(j.data)?j.data:[j.data]; if(d.length>0){var gid=d[0].game_id||d[0].id; if(gid){pm.collectionVariables.set("gameId",String(gid));}}} });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });
pm.test("[Schema] data is array if 200", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); if(pm.response.code===200){pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array");} });

pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON + extract itemId", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); if(j.success&&j.data&&Array.isArray(j.data)&&j.data.length>0){var iid=j.data[0].item_id||j.data[0].id; if(iid){pm.collectionVariables.set("itemId",String(iid));}} });
pm.test("[Schema] valid JSON", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("success"); });
pm.test("[Error] success=false, code=METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.false; pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED"); });
pm.test("[Error] code=ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.false; pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND"); });
pm.test("[Error] code=INVALID_HERO_ID", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.false; pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("INVALID_HERO_ID"); });
pm.test("[Error] code=HERO_NOT_FOUND", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.false; pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("HERO_NOT_FOUND"); });

pm.test("[Message] menyebut wajib/p1/p2", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.false; pm.expect(j.message.toLowerCase()).to.satisfy(function(m){return m.includes("p1")||m.includes("p2")||m.includes("wajib")||m.includes("parameter");}); });
pm.test("[Error] code=MATCH_NOT_FOUND", function () { var j=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.false; pm.expect(j.error.code).to.eql("MATCH_NOT_FOUND"); });
